entities.name: Stanisław Karnkowski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stanisław Karnkowski of Junosza (1520–1603) was the Great Referendary of the Polish Crown, the Great Secretary of Poland, bishop of Włocławek (1567-1580) as well as archbishop of Gniezno and Primate of Poland. He served during the Interrex in 1586–1587, before the coronation of Sigismund III Vasa.

entities.summary: Stanisław Karnkowski of Junosza (1520–1603) was the Great Referendary of the Polish Crown, the Great Secretary of Poland, bishop of Włocławek (1567-1580) as well as archbishop of Gniezno and Primate of Poland.
